- **Q1 FY2026:** Total revenue was about $67.3 billion. This quarter has 12 weeks.
- **Q4 FY2026 (estimated):** Q4 has 16 weeks. Q4 FY2025 revenue was about $86.2 billion. Assuming roughly 8% year-over-year growth, similar to Q1, gives about $93 billion.
- **Change:** $93 billion / $67.3 billion is about 1.39, or roughly +39%.

Nearly all of the increase comes from Q4 being four weeks longer than Q1, not from underlying growth.
